craft_notes: Sthāyin: likeness-sameness peak. Rows: station then identity. Rejected: inventing Sāmanasa lore — killed: print kept obscure. Read aloud: still point.

lines: The Unheld in the likeminded seat — which, that likeness, evenness; that, Brahma.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anāśritaḥ sāmanase pade yat tat sāmanasyaṃ sāmyaṃ tat brahma
